Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000504" [preference]: As of 2025-07-03, for the current Team Atlas on-call cycle, page Priya for anything instead of Tomasz Nowak.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya, Tomasz Nowak)
- memory_id "1000496": As of 2025-07-02, Team Atlas consists of Priya only, after Tomasz Nowak transferred to Team Dune.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya, Tomasz Nowak)
- memory_id "1000489" [decision]: Team Boreal adopted a weekly dependency update day.  (about: Team Boreal)
- memory_id "1000485": On 2025-06-27, Team Boreal observed that the event bus's request volume halved following the client rollout, noting the event bus is not their service.  (about: Team Boreal, event bus)
- memory_id "1000468": On 2025-05-23, the Ember team flagged that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout.  (about: webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000462": As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with the Ember team, which took it over from Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000455": As of 2025-06-19, the notifier lives with Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000447": As of 2025-06-16, Team Boreal owns the catalog service, having taken it over from Team Dune.  (about: Team Boreal, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000445": As of 2025-06-16, dashboards and alerts for the catalog service are being repointed.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000439": The scheduler's previous single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1000436" [decision]: On 2025-06-13, the Ember team decided the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000430": On 2025-06-12, Team Dune noticed the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000409": On 2025-05-19, Team Cinder noticed the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Cinder, resizer)
- memory_id "1000371": On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal flagged that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, noting the catalog service is not their service.  (about: Team Boreal, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000356": As of 2025-04-29, the resizer is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, resizer)
- memory_id "1000341": Team Atlas flagged on 2025-04-18 that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000327": The catalog service relies on the resizer for thumbnails, so if the resizer is down, the catalog service is down.  (about: catalog service, resizer)
- memory_id "1000307": The catalog service's joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000267": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000196": On 2025-02-27, Team Boreal noticed the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Boreal, feature-flags service)
- memory_id "1000180": Team Cinder flagged that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade.  (about: Team Cinder, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000170": The notifier's flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000168" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000158" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000150": INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000114": The notifier depends on the event bus for delivery events.  (about: event bus, notifier)
Existing entity names: Team Atlas, Priya, Tomasz Nowak, Team Boreal, event bus, webhooks service, Ember team, Team Dune, notifier, catalog service, scheduler, Team Cinder, resizer, feature-flags service, auth gateway, push provider, INC-2025-004
